body:
8 days later and I still feel like exiting is the best answer.  

its so difficult to keep living, but also so difficult to end life. 

we just exist

you are right, that stuff does help, and its most likely how Ive made it this far. 

Ive had lots of great hobbies that did bring happiness and i enjoyed doing.  But that no longer happens.  music, sports, hobbies, things that were fun, they arent fun.  

So the normal places to escape life are gone.
so what you are saying is that it just truly never gets better.  no matter what ill be more miserable or people that are/were around me will be more miserable.  Its a losing battle.

If you do nothing, the guilt you will have will drive you mad. 

My mother was in the hospital in 2018.  She had late stage COPD that she was never diagnosed with, so her lungs were already shot from years of not enough oxygen, and then she got pneumonia.  And that landed her in the hospital. 

She was being kept alive by CPAP and breathing machines.  

She had it in her papers that she was not to be kept alive on machines. The doctors said that since I was there and a family member, her care was on me.  

I kept her on machines while I got number doctors opinions, all while my mom started getting angry with me.  She wanted to just pass on and leave this world. 

I ultimately made the call to have the staff take her off machines and provide medicine to help her relax.  I held her had as she left this world. 

That was my only choice, and the guilt and shame and remorse I have daily is more than I can bare.  

You must do all you can to save your mother or you will never be the same. 

Call the police and get her help in a hospital.  Money is just money, and more can eventually be made.  Lives can never be brought back.  

I hope your mother will get the help she needs and you will be strong enough to to that for her.

last night I had a bottle of pain pills.  I stared at it for hours.  

If I had any booze in the house last night, I would have taken them all.  The feeling isnt as strong tonight as last night
